summary:
Implemented the NFC landing slice.

NFC tag landing pages now have `#nfc-scan-handoff`: status buttons, quick note, live preview, Copy, Share, Save Garage Note, and Garage Notes routing. It writes into existing `ridgeline-notes.general_notes` and adds only a small local last-scan receipt. I also added mobile bottom-bar actions, search coverage, cache bump `ridgeline-console-v367`, and smoke coverage.

Verified:
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('nfc-landing.html')`
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('nfc.html')`
`Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
`Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('nfc-landing.html','nfc.html') -Tag audit-v367-nfc-scan-handoff -SkipScreenshots`
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the NFC scan handoff after scanning an actual truck tag, or rotate to Garage/Maintenance visibility outside staging.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: NFC tag landing pages now save scan notes.
Impact Reason: After scanning a physical truck tag, the iPhone path can capture what was checked and send it to Garage Notes without hunting for the notes form.
